pictures.author: Ray in Manila
pictures.observations: Complete photo inspected: broad golden dome, pale ribs and triangular basal panels, open narrow finial lantern, circular tall-windowed drum with pointed surrounds, octagonal middle stage, corner pinnacles and turquoise/cream parapet panels. Cypress trees obscure much of the lower arcade; do not infer an exact shaft inventory from it.

pictures.author: Eviatar Bach
pictures.observations: Complete overview inspected for context only: terraced hillside/garden axis and sea/urban context. Shrine is distant; this does not resolve its lower arcade inventory or exact ground levels.

pictures.author: Bahá’í World News Service
pictures.license: Rights retained by source; viewed only; no pixels copied
pictures.observations: Complete ordinary close exterior photo inspected because the earlier wide view did not resolve the arcade: smoothly rounded pink/pale stone shafts, leafy capitals and torus bases, white corner pier, pointed decorated spandrels/arches, deep covered walk, closed stone core wall, and broad light-stone paving adjoining the colonnade. Low-frequency shared materials should carry stone color; exact carving is simplified.
